attr.title: Prince of Persia 2
attr.desc: Prince of Persia 2: The Shadow and the Flame, the 1993 Macintosh version, running natively: the original program translated to C (unofficial). Save states with pictures, rewind, extras menu.
attr.inst: Copy the disk image of your own copy of the Macintosh version (.hfv, .dsk, .img, .image, .toast, .iso, .cdr or .bin) into ports/pop2.
